_comment: Place as .claude/settings.json in the kit directory (the driver's cwd), and copy hooks/guard.template.sh -> <kit dir>/hooks/guard.sh and hooks/record.template.sh -> <kit dir>/hooks/record.sh (chmod +x). $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is expanded by Claude Code to the kit dir. Disable every plugin the workflow does not need — in our study this cut the fixed per-session startup context roughly in half (~37k -> ~20k tokens). List your installed plugins with `claude plugin list`.
